notes: The economy stops merely disclosing and starts — *gated* — being inherited by the valuation. Grounded against the live code, which had drifted from the spec's original sketch and was better than it: blocks/cost-of-equity.js already accepts an ERP input and already discloses when it falls back to DEFAULT_ERP_PCT = 4.45, so the seam was half-built.
